verdict.rationale: Azure's own pages show a free account and a catalog of free services, and a doc note says the free account is credits on production. That confirms a free starting path exists. The evidence only gives page titles and a one-line characterization, so the story's core requirement of spelled-out limits and expiry is not shown. Missing for 10: documented free-tier usage limits, credit amount and expiry terms, any published startup-credits program, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, starting is free — an always-free tier and/or published startup credits with the limits and expiry spelled out
